A second commit renamed 12 paper-numbered modules to content names and deleted 2 declaration-free stubs. Three commits, each green under the build-inclusive check-module-invariants.sh, with check-metalogic-cycles.sh at exactly 1 and the standing partition gate made non-degenerate.
